why: I checked all five expect lines and their proofs. Each one can be checked at the PR head with local tools only. Lines 1–3 make specific return-value claims, such as "padLeft(42, 5) returns the string '00042'", and each is checked by a `node --input-type=module -e` script that imports from './index.js' and exits non-zero on a mismatch. Line 4 is checked by `grep -q 'padLeft(' test/strutil.test.js && npm test`, which runs in the working tree. Line 5 is checked by a node script that lists the exported functions and matches `^## name\(` in README.md. The shell escaping (`\\\\(` becomes `\(` in the regex) is correct. Every line has a single, unambiguous answer. No line needs a release, a deploy or a published page, and the non-goals explicitly exclude publishing a new npm release.
